item.title: JRuby vs TruffleRuby vs MRI in 2026: Which Ruby Runtime Should You Actually Run?
item.description: Your Rails app is probably running on the same runtime it ran on five years ago, and that runtime is almost certainly MRI — the reference implementation. MRI is excellent, but it is not the only option, and for two very specific workloads it is not the fastest one either. Meanwhile the two alternative runtimes have both shipped major releases in the last month: JRuby 10.1.2.0 on 2026-09-21 and TruffleRuby 40.0.0 on 2026-09-17.
